Lifestyle & Wellness

Health Packages for Modern Lifestyle Risks

Sedentary routines, stress, poor nutrition, and screen-heavy lifestyles create silent health risks. Our lifestyle packages detect diabetes, vitamin deficiencies, obesity markers, and metabolic imbalances early.

Risk Awareness

Common Lifestyle Risk Factors

Modern lifestyles introduce health risks that often go undetected until they become chronic conditions. Regular screening can identify these risks early.

Poor Sleep
Irregular sleep disrupts hormones and immunity.
Chronic Stress
Elevated cortisol leads to heart disease.
Sedentary Work
Prolonged sitting increases risk of obesity.
Poor Nutrition
Nutrient gaps lead to vitamin deficiencies.
Obesity Risk
Excess weight is linked to diabetes.
Substance Use
Smoking and alcohol severely impact organs.

Explore Other Categories

Women's Health Packages

Hormonal, thyroid, PCOS, pregnancy, and bone health screening for women.

Men's Health Packages

Executive health, cardiac risk, liver & kidney screening for men.

Common Questions

Lifestyle Health FAQ

Who should consider a lifestyle health checkup?
Anyone with a sedentary lifestyle, high stress, irregular diet, family history of diabetes or obesity, or those working in high-pressure corporate environments should get a lifestyle health checkup at least once a year. It's especially important after age 25.
What does the Diabetic Care Profile include?
The Diabetic Care Profile includes fasting and post-prandial blood sugar, HbA1c, complete lipid profile, kidney function tests (creatinine, BUN, eGFR), urine microalbumin, and retinal risk markers for comprehensive diabetic monitoring and prevention.
Can vitamin deficiency cause fatigue and brain fog?
Absolutely. Deficiencies in Vitamin D, B12, iron, and folate are among the leading causes of chronic fatigue, brain fog, poor concentration, and weakened immunity. A targeted vitamin panel can identify these issues and guide supplementation.
Are lifestyle packages available for corporate groups?
Yes. We offer corporate wellness packages with on-site sample collection at your office, customizable test panels based on employee demographics, and bulk pricing. Contact us at +91 89408 94079 for a tailored corporate wellness proposal.

From executive health profiles to cardiac risk assessment and metabolic screening — stay ahead of health risks with packages designed for the modern man.

Explore Other Categories

Women's Health Packages

Lifestyle Health Packages

Diabetes, obesity, stress, fitness, and corporate wellness checkups.

Common Questions

Men's Health FAQ

At what age should men start annual health checkups?
Men should begin routine screening at 30. After 40, annual comprehensive checkups including cardiac risk, PSA, liver function, and metabolic panels are strongly recommended. Men with family history of heart disease or diabetes should start earlier.
What does a cardiac risk assessment include?
A cardiac risk assessment includes a complete lipid profile (total cholesterol, LDL, HDL, triglycerides), hs-CRP (high-sensitivity C-reactive protein), homocysteine, Troponin I, blood sugar, and HbA1c to evaluate cardiovascular health comprehensively.
Are executive health packages relevant for younger men?
Absolutely. High-stress professionals in their 30s benefit significantly from executive screening which covers organ function, vitamin levels, cardiac markers, and stress-related metabolic indicators. Early detection of lifestyle-related risks is crucial at this age.
How long does it take to receive reports?
Most reports are delivered digitally within 12–24 hours. Specialized tests like tumor markers, PSA, or genetic panels may take 48–72 hours. You'll receive SMS and email notifications when your reports are ready.

From hormonal health and thyroid function to pregnancy care and bone density — our women's packages are built for every stage of a woman's life.

Recommended For

Who Should Consider Women's Health Packages?

Our women's health packages are designed for proactive care at every life stage — whether you're planning a family, managing a condition, or simply staying ahead of health risks.

Women 20+
Annual wellness screening for early detection of hormonal imbalances, anemia, and nutritional deficiencies.
Pregnancy Planning

PCOS & Hormonal Issues
Targeted profiling for polycystic ovarian syndrome, irregular cycles, and hormonal imbalances.
Menopause & Bone Health
Bone density markers, calcium profiling, and vitamin D assessment for women 45+.
Thyroid Disorders
Comprehensive T3, T4, TSH screening — essential for women with fatigue, weight changes, or family history.
Annual Wellness

Explore Other Categories

Men's Health Packages

Executive health, cardiac risk, liver & kidney screening for men.

Lifestyle Health Packages

Diabetes, obesity, stress, fitness, and corporate wellness checkups.

Common Questions

Women's Health FAQ

When should women start getting regular health checkups?
Women should begin annual preventive health screenings from age 21. After 30, comprehensive panels including thyroid, hormonal, and bone health markers are strongly recommended. Women with a family history of diabetes, heart disease, or cancer should start earlier.
What tests are included in a PCOS screening profile?
A PCOS screening typically includes LH, FSH, total testosterone, DHEA-S, insulin resistance markers (fasting insulin, HOMA-IR), lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, and HbA1c to evaluate both hormonal and metabolic imbalances associated with PCOS.
Is fasting required for women's health packages?
Most packages require 10–12 hours of fasting for accurate blood sugar and lipid results. Water is permitted during the fasting period. Hormonal tests can typically be done without fasting, but your report will indicate if specific conditions apply.
Can I book a home sample collection for women's health packages?
Yes. Free home sample collection is available across Madurai for all women's health packages. Our trained female phlebotomists ensure a comfortable and professional experience. Book online or call +91 89408 94079.
